name: glyhub_GPST000031_N_Kidney
title: Mgat3 wild-type and knockout mouse kidney N-glycan profiles
description: Complete Supplemental Table S2 kidney N-glycan EIC peak-intensity matrix from two Mgat3 wild-type and two Mgat3 knockout source-labelled samples/runs.
details: All 287 author-labelled chromatographic features and all four quantitative columns are retained, including 32 features with multiple candidate compositions and five all-zero source features. The assay contains the source EIC peak intensities, not reporter-ion intensities or total-glycome-normalized percentages. Only assay zeros become NA; raw values and masks are retained. The original percentage block is retained separately as metadata(x)$source_relative_abundance. Each percentage is intensity divided by the corresponding source high-mannose intensity sum, multiplied by 100; column totals can exceed 100%. No averaging, imputation, rescaling, candidate expansion or composition-based feature collapse is performed. The source sample names and run IDs exactly match the four kidney raw files under GPST000031. The related brain accession GPST000027 is not represented by this workbook. The source distinguishes WT and KO samples but does not establish independent biological replication, pairing, sex or age; these are not inferred. Diagnostic MS/MS scan identifiers are retained as evidence, not interpreted as a complete structural assignment.

annotation: 255 features have one source composition, encoded with the explicit Man3GlcNAc2 core plus the stated generic residues; Deoxyhexose maps to generic dHex rather than assumed Fuc. For the 32 multiple-candidate features, typed composition is NA while every candidate and original string remains in source_annotations. Chromatographic subpeak suffixes remain distinct even when compositions are identical. No feature has a validated topology, so no glycan_structure column is created.
